scope: Review and fix six owner-supplied findings. No mainnet acceptance, public deployment or full E2E coverage claim.
subsequentDelta: After 5e648e71c only tests and the decreasing non-null debt allowance changed. Financial implementation, codec, state schema and contracts are unchanged by these subsequent commits.

findings.status: remote DoS not reproduced; redundant lookup removed
findings.detail: Existing unique board membership and unique positive bigint shares guard ran before the asserted lookup. Incoming invalid attestations already return typed rejection. The same guard now returns the validated weight. Five new vectors cover off-board/duplicate signers, valid follow-up, and missing/zero/case-duplicate local shares; local configuration corruption remains an explicit invariant failure.

Strict canonical MessagePack recursively sorts Map key bytes with value bytes as a tie-break. Positional array order is preserved. Review indexed 44 encoder calls in 19 production caller files, plus equality/compare callers. Existing Map/root/golden tests pass. FinTS was corrected to name the actual encoder and its rejection of undefined.

findings.status: faucet infrastructure timing corrected; replay divergence not reproduced
findings.detail: Thirteen elapsed/deadline Date.now calls in four faucet files now use getPerfMs. No reducer timestamps, WAL inputs, UTC authentication deadlines or wall-clock diagnostic timestamps were changed. The delayed real-block journey verifies the bounded wait without advancing chain time.

Protocol units and decoder-minted EntityHeight/UnixMs views already exist; negative type checks pass. J-prefix heights are normalized as non-negative safe integers and checked against the exact Entity/J context. targetEntityHeight denotes Entity height, not J height. Full propagation through committed number schemas was not introduced (FinTS 5.3).
last=NaN previously returned the entire 201-event test timeline. Malformed/fractional/unsafe inputs now return HTTP400 via the existing uint decoder; default200, clamp1..5000 and event order remain.

0x7a69junk previously parsed as31337; fractions were floored and unsafe integers rounded. Full hex is parsed as BigInt and checked by the existing safe uint boundary before conversion. Invalid IDs fail before jurisdiction selection/deployment; supported safe numeric IDs remain.
